content:
Life has the knack of springing unpleasant surprises like accidents and potentially upsetting one’s dream and causing financial hardship as well. You can take on the challenges life throws at you with confidence with SBI General’s Group Personal Accident Insurance Policy.
Features
Coverage on Loss of Life due to Accident or Permanent Total Disability
Child Education Cover
Repatriation & Funeral expenses
Adaptation allowance (Home & Vehicle)
Ambulance cover
For individuals aged between 18-65 years
Coverage
Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability (PTD)
Child Education - covers up to max. of 1% of accidental death’s sum insured or ₹ 20000/- whichever is lower for first & second child of insured member (In case of death or PTD admissible claim)
Repatriation & Funeral expenses – 1% of accidental death’s sum insured subject to the maximum of ₹ 10000/-
Adaptation allowance (Home & Vehicle) - 1% accidental death’s sum insured subject to the maximum of ₹ 20,000, in case of Permanent Total Disability(PTD) admissible claim
Ambulance cover – 1% accidental death’s sum insured up to the maximum of ₹ 1500/- per incident /accident towards admissible claim of death or Permanent Total Disability(PTD).
How to Buy
Log in to YONO SBI app
Go to Insurance section
Tap on Buy a Policy and select Personal Accident Insurance and proceed with the policy purchase.
Download YONO SBI
